Package Model.Repository

Class CourseRepository

java.lang.Object
Model.Repository.CourseRepository
public class CourseRepository extends Object
Repository for managing Course entities and enrollments under a given Business.

Uses Firestore subcollections for courses and a top‐level collection for enrollments.

    • getAllEnrollmentsByClient

      public com.google.android.gms.tasks.Task<List<Enrollment>> getAllEnrollmentsByClient(Client client)
      Retrieves all Enrollment documents from Firestore that belong to the specified Client.

      This method queries the enrollment collection and applies a filter on the nested field client.id to match the provided client's unique identifier. It then deserializes the resulting documents into Enrollment objects and collects them into a list.

      Firestore schema expectation:

       enrollment (collection)
   └── {enrollmentId} (document)
         └── client (map)
               └── id (string)
      Parameters:
      client - the Client whose enrollments should be retrieved. If null, the task resolves immediately with an empty list.
      Returns:
      a Task that resolves to a List of Enrollment objects associated with the given client. If no enrollments exist, the list will be empty.
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if the Firestore query fails and the task’s exception is null.

    • getUpcomingCoursesByClient

      public com.google.android.gms.tasks.Task<List<Enrollment>> getUpcomingCoursesByClient(Client client, ZoneId zone)
      Convenience overload that fetches the next seven upcoming course enrollments for the given client, using zone to determine the current time.

      An “upcoming” enrollment is any record whose time (a per-occurrence Timestamp) is greater than or equal to “now” computed in the provided ZoneId.

      This delegates to getUpcomingCoursesByClient(Client, ZoneId, int) with limit = 7.

      Parameters:
      client - the client whose upcoming enrollments should be returned; must not be null
      zone - the time zone used to compute “now” when filtering upcoming enrollments; must not be null
      Returns:
      a Task that resolves to a list (possibly empty) of at most seven Enrollment items ordered by ascending time; the task may fail with the underlying Firestore exception (e.g., FirebaseFirestoreException)
